slides.texte_overlay:
How to stay relaxed when
you're seeing someone new
Keep living your own life. Your gym, your friends, your hobbies. When your whole week doesn't revolve around her texts, you stay calm and far more interesting.
Don't plan the whole future after one great evening. Enjoy where you are. Thinking three months ahead is exactly what creates pressure on something still very new.
Text like a normal person. Reply when you see it, say what you mean, no strategy. Games make both of you anxious. Simple and honest keeps things relaxed for both of you.
Say what you enjoyed about the time together. "I had a great time at the market with you." Clear, warm words remove the guessing that makes new dating stressful.
Plan easy dates. A walk, a coffee, cooking together. Low-pressure plans let you both be yourselves instead of performing at an expensive dinner every single time.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. You'll always have something new to share, and conversations will feel easy instead of tense.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. You'll always have something new to share with her.

slides.texte_overlay: Remember it's allowed to not work out. Not every connection becomes a relationship, and that's fine. Accepting that takes away the fear and lets you actually enjoy it.
